summary.lead: Official summary (Congressional Research Service, Introduced in House):

blocks.text: Recognizing Community Organizations for Veteran Engagement and Recovery Act or the RECOVER Act

This bill requires the Department of Veterans Affairs to implement a three-year pilot program to make grants to established non-profit mental health care providers to provide culturally competent, evidence-based mental health care for veterans.

This bill creates a three-year pilot program run by the Department of Veterans Affairs. Under the program, the department would give grants to established non-profit mental health care providers. The grants would pay for mental health care for veterans that is culturally competent and based on evidence.
